identity.title: Verify Blob and Contour candidate explanation matches one execution

origin.summary: 2D-032 requires a focused contract for Blob/Contour candidate identity, acceptance, reject reason, applied limits, coordinate frame, and final result parity.

state.current_summary: 2D-032 Blob/Contour candidate explanation and one-execution result parity is verified through the existing SDK candidate capture, filter, object-result, overlay, metric, and Run History owners; no relaxed rerun or candidate abstraction was added.

objective.summary: Prove that Blob and Contour candidate explanations retain one execution snapshot's identity, accepted state, reject reason, applied limits, coordinate frame, final ResultCount/metrics, overlays, and Run History rows at ROI and dimension boundaries.
constraints: Reuse TryCaptureSdkCandidates/CaptureCandidates, the existing Blob/Contour execution and filter owners, object result rows, overlays, metrics, and Run History; do not reimplement candidate collection or add a relaxed Tool rerun.
Use isolated deterministic synthetic fixtures under D:\OpenVisionLab-TestData\OpenVisionLab_Dev; preserve current candidate ordering/API and save/reopen semantics.
Do not touch Original, release, deploy, hardware, or external systems.

criteria.text: Mixed accepted/rejected Blob and Contour candidates retain stable CandidateId, NativeIndex, RegionIndex, source-coordinate bounds, generation stage, and CoordinateFrame from one execution.
Exact MIN/MAX area and width/height boundaries produce reject reasons and AppliedLimits consistent with the candidate values and accepted rows without changing ordering.

Multi-ROI and same-area candidates preserve region separation, deterministic ordering, final ResultCount/area metrics, accepted overlays, and Run History candidate rows from the same execution snapshot.
Focused Debug/Release contract and documentation record the existing owner/call path and unverified WPF/render/DPI/hardware limits.

evidence.observation: Debug Blob/Contour boundary contract passed for mixed accepted/rejected candidates, same-area targets across ROI 0/1, exact area and width/height boundaries, CandidateId/native/region identity, SourceImage geometry, reject code/text, AppliedLimits, final metrics, accepted overlays, deterministic repeat order, and Run History row parity.
Release Blob/Contour boundary contract passed with the same one-execution candidate, ROI, exact-limit, metric, overlay, deterministic-order, and Run History observations as Debug.

Focused object-candidate parity, object-dimension filter, expected-failure, and Preview/Run/Reopen regressions exited 0; the existing Blob/Contour parity contract retained mask/multi-ROI rows, accepted overlays, metrics, timing, and public Good/Bad replay.

Documentation records the existing SDK candidate/object-result call path, exact boundary and same-snapshot semantics, next 2D-033 priority, and the unverified WPF EXE/theme/DPI/monitor/hardware limits.

events.summary: Close 2D-032 as a deterministic contract-only slice: retain the existing Blob/Contour SDK candidate and object-result owners, prove ROI/dimension boundary explanation parity with one execution snapshot, and leave WPF/runtime qualification outside this slice.
All 2D-032 criteria have active Debug/Release boundary and focused regression evidence with durable documentation; the remaining WPF/runtime qualification is explicitly outside this slice.
